newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf Capital says has no merger plans.
newsitem.headline: MBf Capital says has no merger plans.

text.p: MBf Capital Bhd said there was no known reason for the unusually high trading volume in its shares in the last few days.
It said in reply to a query from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that it was aware of media speculation about possible merger between itself and Suria Capital Holdings Bhd.
"We are not aware of any other rumours or other conditions that exist," it said.
MBf Capital said it was constantly exploring good business opportunities.
However, at the moment, no disclosure was required on any business opportunities and appropriate disclosure would be made if and when agreement is reached on any such opportunity, it said.
On Monday, MBf Capital stock closed 45 cents higher at 5.05 ringgit, while Suria Capital was unchanged at 3.06 ringgit. The two were also among the most active stocks of the day.
